post.originalText:
GPT-6 Astra vs Claude Opus 5.5 

I gave both AI models the exact same prompt:

"Build an interactive laptop made entirely of honey jelly."

Both built it from scratch. No extra instructions.

Here's what it cost:

Claude Opus 5.5 — $14.36
GPT-6 Astra — $7.75

Astra was 46% cheaper

But did the cheaper model do a better job?

Watch the side-by-side comparison and judge for yourself
